import sys

MOD = 1000000007
MAX_D = 64
MAX_LG = 65

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n_val = int(input_data[0])
    d_val = int(input_data[1])
    n_val -= 1
    orig = n_val
    
    digit_list = []
    while n_val > 0:
        digit_list.append(n_val % d_val)
        n_val //= d_val
    
    # MatrixNode class
    class MatrixNode:
        def __init__(self):
            self.mat = [[0] * MAX_D for _ in range(MAX_D)]
            self.buf = [[0] * MAX_D for _ in range(MAX_D)]
            self.flag = [False] * MAX_D
            self.tmp = [False] * MAX_D
        
        def combine(self, other):
            # Reset buf to zeros
            for i in range(MAX_D):
                for j in range(MAX_D):
                    self.buf[i][j] = 0
            
            for i in range(d_val + 1):
                for j in range(d_val + 1):
                    for k in range(d_val + 1):
                        self.buf[i][j] = (self.buf[i][j] + self.mat[k][j] * other.mat[i][k]) % MOD
            
            for i in range(d_val):
                if self.flag[i] and not other.flag[i]:
                    for j in range(d_val + 1):
                        self.buf[i][j] = self.mat[i][j]
                if not self.flag[i] and other.flag[i]:
                    for j in range(d_val + 1):
                        self.buf[j][i] = other.mat[j][i]
                self.flag[i] = self.flag[i] or other.flag[i]
            
            # Copy buf to mat
            for i in range(MAX_D):
                for j in range(MAX_D):
                    self.mat[i][j] = self.buf[i][j]
        
        def zeroize(self):
            for i in range(MAX_D):
                for j in range(MAX_D):
                    self.mat[i][j] = 0
                    self.buf[i][j] = 0
        
        def rotate(self, shift_amount):
            # Reset buf to zeros
            for i in range(MAX_D):
                for j in range(MAX_D):
                    self.buf[i][j] = 0
            
            for i in range(d_val):
                for j in range(d_val):
                    self.buf[(i + shift_amount) % d_val][(j + shift_amount) % d_val] = self.mat[i][j]
                self.buf[(i + shift_amount) % d_val][d_val] = self.mat[i][d_val]
            
            for i in range(d_val):
                self.buf[d_val][(i + shift_amount) % d_val] = self.mat[d_val][i]
            
            self.buf[d_val][d_val] = self.mat[d_val][d_val]
            
            # Copy buf to mat
            for i in range(MAX_D):
                for j in range(MAX_D):
                    self.mat[i][j] = self.buf[i][j]
            
            # Update flag
            for i in range(d_val):
                self.tmp[i] = self.flag[(i + shift_amount) % d_val]
            for i in range(d_val):
                self.flag[i] = self.tmp[i]
    
    # Initialize seg_tree and pref_tree
    seg_tree = [MatrixNode() for _ in range(MAX_LG)]
    pref_tree = [MatrixNode() for _ in range(MAX_LG)]
    work_node = MatrixNode()
    
    def compute_node(x):
        block = x
        block_size = 1
        depth = -1
        while block >= d_val:
            block //= d_val
            block_size *= d_val
            depth += 1
        
        x %= block_size
        if depth == -1:
            return pref_tree[block]
        
        res = MatrixNode()
        res.mat = [row[:] for row in seg_tree[depth].mat]
        res.flag = seg_tree[depth].flag[:]
        work_node.mat = [row[:] for row in seg_tree[depth].mat]
        work_node.flag = seg_tree[depth].flag[:]
        
        for step in range(1, block):
            work_node.rotate(1)
            res.combine(work_node)
        
        work_node = compute_node(x)
        work_node.rotate(block)
        res.combine(work_node)
        return res
    
    # Initialize pref_tree[0]
    pref_tree[0].mat[d_val][d_val] = 2
    pref_tree[0].mat[d_val][0] = -1
    pref_tree[0].mat[0][d_val] = 1
    pref_tree[0].flag[0] = True
    seg_tree[0] = MatrixNode()
    seg_tree[0].mat = [row[:] for row in pref_tree[0].mat]
    seg_tree[0].flag = pref_tree[0].flag[:]
    
    for idx in range(1, d_val):
        pref_tree[idx].mat[d_val][d_val] = 2
        pref_tree[idx].mat[d_val][idx] = -1
        pref_tree[idx].mat[idx][d_val] = 1
        pref_tree[idx].flag[idx] = True
        seg_tree[0].combine(pref_tree[idx])
        pref_tree[idx] = MatrixNode()
        pref_tree[idx].mat = [row[:] for row in seg_tree[0].mat]
        pref_tree[idx].flag = seg_tree[0].flag[:]
    
    for lvl in range(1, len(digit_list) + 1):
        seg_tree[lvl] = MatrixNode()
        seg_tree[lvl].mat = [row[:] for row in seg_tree[lvl - 1].mat]
        seg_tree[lvl].flag = seg_tree[lvl - 1].flag[:]
        work_node = MatrixNode()
        work_node.mat = [row[:] for row in seg_tree[lvl - 1].mat]
        work_node.flag = seg_tree[lvl - 1].flag[:]
        
        for j in range(1, d_val):
            work_node.rotate(1)
            seg_tree[lvl].combine(work_node)
    
    final_result = compute_node(orig)
    print(final_result.mat[d_val][d_val])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
